synthesis.paragraph: In today's issue, "Public transit and shared micromobility bundles" shares 4 references with "MaaS bundle uptake among university students," including the paper "Apollo: A flexible, powerful and customisable freeware package for choice model estimation and application" by Stephane Hess and David Palma (2019). This 2019 paper by Hess and Palma is cited by 2 papers today and was last cited 12 days ago. Additionally, "MaaS bundle uptake among university students" shares 10 references with the June 15, 2026 paper "Does the mobility-as-a-service platform alleviate traffic congestion in China?". Another paper today, "Uncertainty and Value of Information analysis in the Integrated Transport and Health Impact Modelling Tool for Global Cities (ITHIM-Global)," shares 8 references with a June 19, 2026 paper titled "Description, development and application of the integrated transport and health impact modelling tool for global cities (ITHIM-global)." Finally, Giuseppe Inturri is an author on 2 of today's papers, and 1 paper today cites earlier papers from this archive.
